name: shot-lane
prompt: Tilt-shift photograph of a handmade miniature diorama like an architect's model on a table, seen from above at a gentle three-quarter angle, shallow depth of field, tiny model people, warm sand, terracotta and sage-green palette. Close on a lane of colourful kirana shops at dusk, under a surreal luminous sky of violet, magenta and deep purple with a band of gold low behind distant hills. The shop fronts glow with warm light, rows of colourful snack packets hang at their fronts, tiny shoppers reach for packets, a green auto-rickshaw waits at the kerb and the first street lamp glows. In the foreground, at the lane's end on a warehouse forecourt, a folding table under a small tarpaulin canopy holds stacks of snack packets, and a short queue of tiny warehouse workers in overalls buys them from a tiny man with a cash box. A thin softly glowing green painted path runs along the road past the table into the lane. No lettering, no words or numbers on any sign, paper or screen, no logos.
postprocess: WebP q82; the PNG original stays local in src/
use: smartclearance.com's hero film (SC-111): a plate of the journey's day, and a poster for the film
